mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening residential demand, which typically precedes higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.5%, it signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases real discount rates for equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong economic expansion with the Federal Reserve responding to overheating, which typically generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), the tight labor market supports sustained consumer spending and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher real interest rates, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise and industrial production (INDPRO) fall, it indicates a shift from manufacturing to residential construction, signaling a rebalancing economy with strong consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-housing boom recovery regime (HOUST > 1200.0), rising housing starts signal sustained residential sector recovery, driving consumer confidence and corporate investment, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200.0.
